This role is ideal for someone who enjoys improving operational efficiency, influencing service management outcomes, and enabling teams to deliver exceptional customer-focused services.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Role title: Nurse Unit Manager (Level 2)

Role type: Permanent full time

Department and location: Intensive Care Unit, St Vincent's Hospital, Darlinghurst

Salary: $137,104.41 + super. 

Better and fairer care. Always.

We are St Vincent's Health Australia, Australia's largest not-for-profit provider of health and aged care services. 

Founded by The Sisters of Charity in 1857, our +30,000 healthcare superheroes operate public and private hospitals, residential aged care, community and virtual care, and outreach programs. 

About the role

Provide clinical and operational leadership for the General, Neurosurgical and Trauma Intensive Care Unit, ensuring the delivery of safe, high-quality, patient-centred care.

Lead and support the nursing and multidisciplinary team to promote excellence in clinical practice, staff development, and continuous quality improvement.

Manage the day-to-day operations of the unit, including workforce, resources, and patient flow, to ensure efficient and effective service delivery.

Work collaboratively with the Nurse Unit Manager - Cardiothoracic and Transplant ICU to support the operational management of the entire Intensive Care Service and ensure seamless care across specialties.

This position is rostered to 8-hour weekday morning, day and evening shifts and reports directly to the ICU Nurse Manager.

About you

Currently registered as a Registered Nurse (Division 1) with the Australian Health Professionals Regulation Agency

Recognised post graduate tertiary qualification in Intensive Care or management (or willingness to undertake same within 12 months) or equivalent relevant experience

Demonstrated operational, financial, human resource, workplace health and safety experience and well-developed leadership, communication and interpersonal skills

Comprehensive understanding and knowledge of clinical governance and current nursing issues

Ability to promote, evidenced based, patient centred care within a complex environment

Demonstrated evidence of integration of theoretical knowledge and clinical skills, critical thinking and analysis in your daily practice

Why work at St Vincent's?

Join us on our mission to provide care to all, including the most at-risk people in our community

Discounted access to many gyms for you and your family with Fitness Passport

Access to discounted private health insurance with Medibank

Access to a government salary sacrifice program. Make a proportion of your salary tax-free

Committed to financial support for educational development, scholarship programs, paid study leave

Moving from NSW Health? Your eligible accrued leave entitlements will be transferred over. (As restrictions apply to the amount and type of leave that can transfer, feel free to discuss this with our team during the recruitment process)

About the hospital

In this role you will be based at St Vincent's hospital, Darlinghurst.

A busy inner-city hospital in a beautiful location

Surrounded by great cafes, galleries and theatres, parks, nightlife, and nearby glorious beaches

A place of expert clinical care for at-risk people

Closely partnered with universities & affiliated research institutes, many of which are located on campus

Centres of excellence include heart & lung transplantation, bone marrow transplantation, cardiology, cancer care, AIDS-HIV, respiratory medicine, mental health, homeless health, drug & alcohol services, and correctional health 

Sponsorship - work rights for Australia

Please note, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For this role you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or have an Australia visa that grants you the work rights necessary for the role.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the completion of all role-required pre-employment checks, including relevant immunisations.

Equal opportunity

We celebrate diversity & inclusion and are committed to equal employment opportunity for everyone.

As part of our commitment to reconciliation, we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in delivering care that heals body, mind, spirit and community.

How to apply

The closing date for applications is 16 July 2026.

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting how your interest, skills, and experience align with each of the things listed in the About You section of this job advert.

New FY26-27 wage increase to be announced soon. All approved increases will be backdated to 1 July once implemented. 

Respectfully, this role is not open to recruitment agencies.

As part of our Commitment to Reconciliation and Closing the Gap in employment related outcomes, we encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples.

result.description:
Software Developer
Mansys Pty Ltd is recruiting on behalf of Sonar Technologies International
Location: Macquarie Park, NSW
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: $80,000–$90,000 plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience
About the Company
Sonar Technologies International is an Australian technology company specialising in enterprise mobility and smart business solutions.
Sonar develops and implements software products that automate operational workflows across transport and logistics, mobile workforce management, warehousing, field services, retail and healthcare. Its solutions provide capabilities such as job scheduling, dispatch management, route optimisation, real-time tracking, inventory management, reporting and integration with existing ERP and CRM platforms.
About the Role
The role will primarily involve C# and .NET application development, API integration, database-driven software solutions and the deployment of applications through modern cloud and container environments.
Key Responsibilities
•	Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and existing application workflows.
•	Develop, maintain and enhance software applications using C#, .NET and related technologies.
•	Design, develop and test APIs used to integrate Sonar applications with customer, ERP, CRM and third-party systems.
•	Write maintainable and appropriately documented program code in accordance with technical specifications and development standards.
•	Identify limitations and deficiencies in existing applications and recommend suitable software improvements.
•	Test, debug and correct application errors to ensure systems perform reliably and according to specification.
•	Assist in upgrading legacy .NET applications and APIs to current frameworks and development standards.
•	Develop and maintain database-driven functionality using SQL and relational database technologies.
•	Develop and maintain automated build, testing and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines.
•	Assist with the deployment and operation of applications in cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.
•	Monitor application performance, investigate runtime issues and implement software-level fixes.
•	Develop internal utilities and automation tools using technologies such as Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash.
•	Prepare and maintain technical documentation, deployment instructions and operational procedures.
•	Work with software architects, developers, project teams and support personnel throughout the software development lifecycle.
Qualifications and Experience
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one year of relevant software development or closely related commercial experience.
•	Practical experience developing applications or APIs using C# and .NET.
•	Experience with REST APIs and system integration.
•	Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.
•	Familiarity with CI/CD tools and source-control platforms such as Bitbucket or Git.
Desirable Skills
•	Experience modernising legacy .NET applications.
•	Experience developing software for logistics, workforce management, warehousing, healthcare or other operational environments.
•	Knowledge of real-time data processing, GPS, mobile applications, reporting systems or ERP/CRM integration.
•	Experience with Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash scripting.
•	Understanding of application monitoring tools and cloud-based observability
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

result.description: NATIONWIDE WORKFORCE   Nationwide Workforce of behalf of KMN SONS PTY LTD     Company: KMN SONS PTY LTD  ACN: 631 737 507   ABN: 20 631 737 507  Position: Carpenter  Location: Pakenham, VIC 3810  Salary: $90,000 per annum + Superannuation  Employment Type: Full-Time (Permanent)(38hrs/week)  KMN SONS PTY LTD is a carpentry and construction company based in Pakenham, Victoria Business is seeking a motivated and skilled Carpenter to join the growing team. This is a full-time permanent opportunity for an experienced tradesperson who takes pride in delivering high-quality work and enjoys working on a variety of residential and commercial construction projects. As a  Carpenter , you will be responsible for delivering high-quality carpentry services across a diverse range of residential and commercial construction projects. The role involves undertaking all aspects of carpentry, including framing, fixing, lock-up, maintenance and repair work. You will interpret construction drawings and specifications, construct, install and repair timber structures and fittings, and ensure all work is completed in accordance with the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards, project specifications and Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) requirements.      Benefits   Competitive salary of $90,000 per annum plus superannuation.  Permanent full-time employment with long-term career opportunities.  Supportive and professional team environment.  Opportunity to work on diverse residential and commercial construction projects.  Ongoing skill development and career progression opportunities.    Task & responsibilities  Main duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:   Interpret architectural drawings, building plans and specifications to determine project requirements and construction methods.   Measure, mark, cut and assemble timber, wood products and other construction materials using hand tools, power tools and woodworking machinery.   Construct and install timber wall frames, roof frames, floor systems, roof trusses and structural components for residential and commercial buildings.   Carry out first-fix (framing) carpentry work, including the installation of structural frameworks in accordance with approved plans and building codes.   Perform second-fix (fixing) carpentry work, including the installation of doors, door frames, windows, skirting boards, architraves, staircases, handrails and internal timber finishes.   Complete lock-up stage carpentry by installing external doors, windows, cladding, fascia, eaves and other external timber components to secure the building structure.   Undertake maintenance, repair and renovation work on existing residential and commercial properties, including replacing damaged timber structures and fixtures.   Install timber flooring, decking, pergolas, fencing, partitions, ceilings and other internal and external carpentry features.   Inspect completed carpentry work to ensure compliance with the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and project specifications.   Select, maintain and safely operate carpentry tools, machinery and equipment to ensure efficient and safe work practices.   Estimate material requirements, minimise waste and maintain appropriate stock levels for ongoing construction projects.   Work collaboratively with builders, supervisors, subcontractors and other trades to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently and within required timeframes.   Identify construction defects or installation issues and carry out corrective work to achieve the required quality standards.   Comply with Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) policies by maintaining a safe, clean and organised worksite and using appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).   Assist in supervising and providing on-the-job guidance to apprentices, labourers and junior carpenters where required.   Maintain accurate records of work completed, materials used and any variations or site issues encountered during construction.   Perform any other duties reasonably directed by management that are consistent with the position of Carpenter.    Qualification & experience   Minimum Certificate III in Carpentry or an equivalent relevant qualification.  Current White Card (preferred).  Valid driver's licence is an advantage.    Skills & Experience Required    Minimum 1 year of relevant carpentry experience.  Sound knowledge of carpentry techniques, building materials, and construction practices.  Ability to read and interpret building plans and specifications.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.  Good communication and teamwork skills.  Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines.    Australian Permanent Residents and Citizens are encouraged to apply.      About Company     KMN SONS PTY LTD  (ACN: 631 737 507) is a Victorian-owned carpentry and construction company based in  Pakenham, Victoria , specialising in residential and commercial carpentry services. The company provides a comprehensive range of carpentry solutions, including timber framing, first-fix and second-fix carpentry, lock-up works, renovations, repairs and general carpentry services for builders, developers and private clients throughout Melbourne and surrounding regions.  The business has established a reputation for delivering high-quality workmanship, reliable service and projects completed to strict quality and safety standards. KMN SONS PTY LTD is committed to ensuring all work is undertaken in accordance with the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) requirements while maintaining strong relationships with its clients through professionalism, efficiency and attention to detail.
